title: Flooding Emergency
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report hazardous/emergency flooding conditions. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.
instructions: Call 311 to report hazardous or emergency flooding conditions. This request must be dispatched.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about hazardous or emergency flooding.
actions.why: Report hazardous or emergency flooding conditions. The description for "Flooding Emergency" requests on the Dallas 311 website says this service must be dispatched by phone.
